name: MonarchReadReceipt
title: ReadReceipt
wrapsNative: HStack of an SF Symbol or MonarchAvatarGroup and Text; Button when it opens the list of readers
summary: "Seen", "Seen by 3" or the readers' avatars under the newest message the other people have read, with the full list of names for VoiceOver.
whenToUse: Under the newest message of a conversation that the other people have read, fed by the product with who has read it.
whenNotToUse: Not for delivery or sending states of a message; show those in the message itself. Not for presence in a document; use MonarchPresenceAvatars.
api: init(_ readers: [MonarchReadReceiptReader], display: MonarchReadReceiptDisplay = .text, maxAvatars: Int = 3, labels: MonarchReadReceiptLabels = MonarchReadReceiptLabels(), onShowReaders: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchReadReceiptReader.init(id: String? = nil, name: String, avatarURL: URL? = nil)
enum MonarchReadReceiptDisplay { case text, count, avatars }
MonarchReadReceiptLabels.init(seen: String? = nil, seenByCount: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, seenBy: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, list: (@Sendable ([String]) -> String)? = nil)

options.name: readers
options.description: The people who have read the message, without the sender. Nothing is drawn while it is empty.

options.name: display
options.description: "Seen" with a check mark, "Seen by 3" with a check mark, or the readers' avatars with "Seen".

options.name: maxAvatars
options.description: With the avatars display, at most this many faces, then a "+N" tile. At least one face is shown, and a "+1" tile is replaced by the face it would hide.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Seen", "Seen by 3", "Seen by …" and the joining of names.

options.name: onShowReaders
options.description: Makes the receipt a button, for example to open the list of readers with times.

states.name: empty
states.description: Nothing is drawn and nothing is read.

states.name: avatars
states.description: Overlapping avatars of the readers, a "+N" tile for the rest, and "Seen".

states.name: button
states.description: With onShowReaders the receipt is a button with a 44-point tall touch target.

appearance: Caption text and the check mark in the muted text colour; avatars with a ring in the surface colour. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Same displays and wording as the web. The web's align property is not offered: the conversation's own stack aligns the receipt. Avatars are 24 points, the smallest MonarchAvatar size, where the web uses 16 pixels. The web's double check glyph is a single check mark SF Symbol, because SF Symbols has no double check. Names are joined with the locale's list format, so English locales may add a serial comma. The full sentence is shown on pointer hover with help(_:).
accessibility: The receipt is one element whose label is the full sentence, "Seen by Ana, Ben and Chen", in every display.
The mark and the avatars are hidden from VoiceOver.
With onShowReaders the element has the button trait and a touch target at least 44 points high; without it, the static text trait.
The text and the avatars scale with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A maxAvatars of 0 or less still shows one face.
With one reader more than maxAvatars, all faces are shown instead of a "+1" tile.
